item.title: Overcome Experience Gatekeeping 🚀 • Identify key skills in job description. • Match your projects to these skills. • Quantify your achievements with numbers. • Use: “I led a team to increase sales by 30%.” • Prepare a concise, compelling pitch. What project can you quantify to showcase your value beyond years? #resume #jobsearch #ScalePilot #SocialPilot #AIAutomations
